# Noor-e-ilahi

> Free, verified, ad-free global Islamic platform providing accurate prayer times, the Noble Quran, authentic duas, spherical Qibla direction, Zakat calculator, and holy Ziyarat directory.

## Core Islamic Services
- [Astronomical Prayer Times](https://www.nooreilahi.com/prayer-times): Precision solar prayer timetable with 6 global calculation conventions (MWL, ISNA, Umm Al-Qura, Karachi, Egyptian, Tehran), Hanafi/Standard Asr jurisprudence, and daily Qada tracker.
- [The Noble Quran](https://www.nooreilahi.com/quran): Complete 114 Surahs in authentic Uthmani script with 11 global translations, verse audio recitation by world-renowned Qaris, and Tafsir.
- [Authentic Duas & Daily Adhkar](https://www.nooreilahi.com/duas): Verified supplications from Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim) with Arabic text, transliteration, audio, and interactive digital tasbeeh.
- [Spherical Qibla Direction](https://www.nooreilahi.com/qibla): Great-Circle forward azimuth bearing and interactive sensor compass directly oriented toward the Holy Kaaba in Makkah (21.4225° N, 39.8262° E).
- [Global Islamic Map](https://www.nooreilahi.com/map): Interactive OpenStreetMap directory of 36+ revered dargahs, holy ziyarat points, and historic mosques with live GPS navigation.
- [Classical Ziyarat & Dargahs](https://www.nooreilahi.com/ziyarat): Academically audited sanctuaries across Makkah, Madinah, Jerusalem, Karbala, Najaf, Delhi, Ajmer Sharif, Konya, and Istanbul with visitor etiquette.
- [Zakat & Sadaqah Hub](https://www.nooreilahi.com/zakat): Dynamic 2.5% wealth calculation priced in local country currencies with live Gold/Silver Nisab standards and 8 Quranic recipient channels.
- [Prayer & Purification Guides](https://www.nooreilahi.com/guides): Step-by-step illustrated guides for Wudu (ablution), Ghusl (full wash), Salah unit-by-unit with 4 Sunni Madhabs, and Qada journal.
- [Hajj & Umrah Pilgrimage Portal](https://www.nooreilahi.com/hajj-umrah): Visual pilgrimage rites from Miqat stations and Ihram rules to Tawaf, Sa'i, Arafat, Jamarat, and packing checklists.
- [Salatul Janazah & Bereavement](https://www.nooreilahi.com/janazah): Dignified Islamic funeral prayer guide with 4 Takbeers, adult and child supplications, shrouding (Kafan), Ghusl, and condolence etiquette.
- [Islamic Travel Mode & Qasr](https://www.nooreilahi.com/travel): Authoritative fiqh rules for traveling Muslims, 77km (48 miles) Safar distance, shortening 4-Rak'ah prayers, and traveler duas.
- [Daily Islamic Etiquette (Adab)](https://www.nooreilahi.com/etiquette): Prophetic manners and noble akhlaq across 13 domains of daily Muslim life.
- [Islamic Nikah & Family Guide](https://www.nooreilahi.com/nikah): Marital fiqh, 5 mandatory pillars, Mahr guidelines, Khutbat al-Hajah, valid consent, and family harmony.
- [NOOR Kids & Family](https://www.nooreilahi.com/kids): Engaging Islamic education for children featuring 28 Arabic alphabet letters with audio, Prophet stories, and family quizzes.
- [Hijri Calendar & Sacred Events](https://www.nooreilahi.com/calendar): Astronomical lunar dates, Ramadan fasting schedules, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Ashura, and holy Islamic months.
- [NOOR Watch Media](https://www.nooreilahi.com/watch): 24/7 live continuous video streams from Masjid al-Haram in Makkah and Al-Masjid an-Nabawi in Madinah.

## Platform Policies & Governance
- [Canonical Sources & Scholarly Methodology](https://www.nooreilahi.com/sources): Strict zero-synthetic-invention policy adhering to Kutub al-Sittah (Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim) and scholarly consensus.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nooreilahi.com/privacy): Privacy-first governance ensuring zero ad tracking, zero user data selling, and zero third-party profiling.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.nooreilahi.com/terms): Official terms of use for Noor-e-ilahi web and mobile platforms.
- [Contact & Support](https://www.nooreilahi.com/contact): Direct correspondence for official inquiries, institutional partnerships, and platform feedback.

## Optional
- [Extended Corpus Specification (llms-full.txt)](https://www.nooreilahi.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive multi-page corpus including detailed theological references, astronomical formulas, and full AEO/GEO documentation.
